title: Kernel autoselection v2 — perf results (bench matrix extracts)
content:
Doc purpose
- This is the working “sheet” for kernel auto-selection v2 performance characterization vs v1.
- Values are representative aggregates from perf suite + spot microbenches (not customer traces). Use as directional until GA signoff.
- Units:
  - Prefill latency: ms for prompt ingestion (end-to-end runtime segment; excludes network)
  - Decode latency: ms/token (steady-state; excludes first token)
  - Throughput: tokens/sec for the whole instance (steady-state), with our standard batching policy
  - Delta % is (v2 - v1) / v1

Run metadata (common)
- Runtime branch/tag: runtime-1.21.0-rc3 (selector v2 behind gate)
- Selector v2 commits included:
  - pr-28411 core logic, pr-28439 seq bucketing, pr-28452 GPU SKU registry, pr-28466 telemetry, pr-28473 determinism
  - pr-28522 long-context threshold fix included for runs dated 2026-02-18+
- CUDA/Driver (unless noted):
  - A100: CUDA 12.2 / 535.129
  - H100: CUDA 12.3 / 550.54
  - L40S: CUDA 12.2 / 535.129 (NOTE: known sensitivity on 535.104–535.116; see Known Issues)
- Measurement protocol:
  - 5 min warmup, 20 min sampling, 3 repeats; report median of repeats
  - Request patterns are synthetic distributions (see benchmark matrix doc); results below are bucketed summaries

Sequence buckets (for this sheet)
- S: prompt 256–1,024 tok; output 128–256 tok (decode-heavy)
- M: prompt 2,048–4,096 tok; output 256–512 tok (balanced)
- L: prompt 8,192–16,384 tok; output 512–1,024 tok (prefill-heavy)
- XL: prompt 24,576–32,768 tok; output 512–1,024 tok (long-context / prefill dominated)

TAB: Summary (pass/fail vs goals)
Goals (from perf plan):
- No correctness regressions (tracked separately in conformance); for perf: keep p99 within +2% on any bucket/SKU, and target -5% to -15% p95/p99 improvements in common buckets.

Summary snapshot (2026-02-24):
- H100 (S/M): consistent wins (decode kernel choice) — p99 decode ms/token improved 6–13% across models.
- A100 (S/M): modest wins (2–8%); biggest gains on MoE models where v1 sometimes picked conservative kernels.
- L40S (L/XL): initial regressions observed pre pr-28522; post-fix is neutral to slight win in most cases, but still one open corner case (Qwen2.5-72B XL) where tail is noisy.
- A10 (all): largely neutral; selector tends to fall back to baseline kernels (expected).

TAB: Main table (aggregated)
Columns:
- Model: served variant tested
- GPU SKU: normalized label used by registry
- Bucket: S/M/L/XL
- Prefill p95 (ms): v1 -> v2 (Δ%)
- Decode p99 (ms/tok): v1 -> v2 (Δ%)
- Throughput (tok/s): v1 -> v2 (Δ%)
- Notes: anomalies / flags

TAB: Anomalies / investigation notes
1) Long-context regressions on L40S (pre pr-28522)
- Symptom: +6% to +14% prefill p99 in L/XL buckets on L40S for 70B-class models.
- Root cause (suspected, confirmed by rule diffs): seq-bucket threshold misclassified some 16–24k prompts as “mixed” and selected a kernel optimized for decode throughput but with worse prefill memory behavior.
- Status: pr-28522 adjusted bucket boundaries and rule ordering. Post-fix, most rows are neutral to slightly positive; Qwen2.5-72B XL still noisy.
- Action: rerun Qwen2.5-72B XL on L40S w/ driver 550.54; if persists, add temporary denylist for that kernel+SKU (see ENG-4823).

2) Alert noise / cardinality change (telemetry)
- Not a perf regression but impacted dashboards during perf-canary.
- Kernel selection telemetry added candidate set labels; some queries broke (INT-10411). Ensure dashboards use bounded dimensions.

3) Kernel-switch overhead
- Microbench (benchmark-lab/pr-811) indicates selector eval cost is ~3–9 µs per request on x86 control threads; kernel-switch overhead dominated by cache behavior only when selection flips frequently.
- Mitigation: caching selection decision per (model_id, gpu_sku, seq_bucket, quant_profile) in runtime; v2 now has deterministic key. Still monitoring for mixed workloads where bucket may jitter.

4) Mixed workload stability (scheduler hints)
- Early runs with mixed seq distributions had jitter on A100 due to bucket thrash (S <-> M) when prefill length oscillated.
- Scheduler hint integration (pr-28502) reduces thrash by using observed distribution; not fully reflected in the aggregated table above (only included in some M/L runs dated 2026-02-21+).

TAB: Recommended rollout posture (based on current data)
- Hosted canary default allowlist:
  - Enable v2 on H100 + A100 for S/M buckets across all listed model families.
  - Enable on L40S for S/M; enable on L with caution; XL for L40S should stay gated per-model until Qwen2.5-72B follow-up is green.
- Dedicated/Private guidance:
  - Provide override docs to pin kernel for XL workloads; recommended default remains v1 for long-context on L40S pending follow-up.

Next runs requested (owner -> ETA)
- L40S Qwen2.5-72B XL with driver 550.54 (Isabella -> 2026-02-26)
- A100 XL for Llama-3.1-70B with mixed workload hints enabled (Rina -> 2026-02-27)
- H100 long-context stress (32k prompt, 2k decode) to validate no hidden p99 spikes (Marcus -> 2026-02-28)
